summary_md: **Trig Bundgaard ([@trigbundgaard](https://x.com/trigbundgaard/status/2116744016561861035))** built **StrangerDanger**, a Claude Code plugin with read-only reader agents that limits blast radius from prompt injection and semi-automates OSV vulnerability fixes ([Ubuntu-Buddha/claude-code-stranger-danger](https://github.com/Ubuntu-Buddha/claude-code-stranger-danger)).

claude-code-stranger-danger
CI passing · license MIT · python 3.10+
Readers don't act. Actors don't read.
A Claude Code plugin that protects you from attacks that come from outside (instructions hidden in web pages, documents, email, strangers' code and packages) and limits the damage on your machine if one gets through.
